runtime: D39 exact author Lean 4.31.0 and its preserved Mathlib and Architect imports
scope: CPU proof-body-only comparator. Original import order, prelude, theorem header and separately approved support are fixed per reviewed fixture. No archived tactics, upstream reference body, target identity change or new imports.
acceptance: Same reviewed statement through a source-hash-bound proof slot. Require the exact version diagnostic barrier, named axiom closure with approved axioms only, and no Lean errors. Imports-only absent-target check is required separately for an unresolved benchmark claim. Reject unapproved code, placeholders, sorryAx and foreign axioms.
trusted_control_correction: V1/V2 strict-warning controls showed that unchosen branches in built-in tactics trigger the unreachable and unused tactic linters. V3 submits individual fixed strategies, preserves all strict warnings, and still requires named axiom closure. Change made before any unresolved execution.
accounting: Count resident startup, per proof submission, final replay and shutdown separately. Record the first fully accepted proof and all attempted actions. A failed tactic or a library name unavailable in fixed imports is not proof of unsatisfiability. Same-process wall clock is not GPU time.
controls: Only independently written trusted propositions during baseline setup. Known competition proof artifacts are not baseline inputs. Finite propositions may use kernel decide, not native_decide under the stated axiom policy.
